summary: Apple's Q4 earnings dominate the phone/tech beats (iPhone Duo supply still unpredictable, memory costs set to push prices higher this holiday), alongside a fresh Mercado Bitcoin hack and Anthropic's IPO valuation getting cut amid widening losses. One AI-safety story stands out: 400+ apps with hidden deepfake features got past App Store and Google Play review. knowledge/editorial_profile.md is still a placeholder (run /learn-process) — picks lean on the general rubric and knowledge/process/ SOPs. topics.working_title: iPhone Duo Supply Still Can't Keep Up — And Apple Says Memory Costs Will Push Prices Higher This Holiday
topics.why_now: On Apple's Q4 earnings call (Nov 2), CEO John Ternus said he can't predict when iPhone Duo supply will catch up with demand, with shipping delays stretching into next year. Separately, Apple's inventory (driven by memory chips) grew 154% YoY, and execs warned rising memory costs plus Siri AI expenses will squeeze holiday-quarter margins. Covered by The Verge, TechCrunch and 9to5Mac within hours; Memeburn has nothing on it yet.
topics.angle: Answer what buyers actually want to know: will iPhone Duo stock improve before the holidays, and could rising memory costs mean price hikes elsewhere in Apple's lineup this quarter. Connect the inventory numbers to what shoppers should realistically expect at checkout.
headline_options: iPhone Duo Still Hard to Find: Apple Can't Say When Supply Catches Up
Why Your Next Apple Purchase Might Cost More This Holiday Season
iPhone Duo Shortage Drags On as Apple Warns of Rising Memory Costs

topics.working_title: Brazil's Largest Crypto Exchange Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $46M Hack
topics.why_now: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest crypto exchange, paused deposits and withdrawals after a breach draining assets across 10 chains — Arkham estimates $46M+, CoinDesk reports $40M. Tether has already frozen 4.5M+ USDT linked to the attacker. Covered by Techmeme, CoinDesk and Cointelegraph within hours; still developing and not yet on Memeburn.
topics.angle: Explain what happened, note the fund-amount discrepancy between trackers, what Tether's freeze actually means, and practical guidance for any US-based users or platforms with exposure to the same wallets.
headline_options: Mercado Bitcoin Hack: $46M Drained, Withdrawals Halted
Is Your Crypto Safe? Inside the Mercado Bitcoin Breach and Tether's Freeze

topics.working_title: Hundreds of AI Apps With Hidden Deepfake Features Got Past Apple and Google's Review
topics.why_now: An investigation found 400+ AI apps — apparently from a single organization — hiding sexual and violent deepfake generators behind ordinary photo-editing fronts, on both the App Store and Google Play. Apple separately announced new 18+ age-rating rules for dating and AI companion apps the same day. Reported by 9to5Mac; Memeburn hasn't covered it.
